title: LDL Test
definition: LDL stands for low-density lipoprotein, which carries cholesterol through the blood.
what_it_measures: An LDL cholesterol result describes the level of cholesterol carried by LDL in the blood.
general_information: LDL cholesterol is often called 'bad' cholesterol because excess LDL cholesterol can contribute to plaque buildup in blood vessels.

source.title: LDL and HDL Cholesterol and Triglycerides
